schedules.name: daisy-daily-9am-checkin
schedules.text: Daily 9 AM check-in: review the prior calendar day workspace/daily_notes and necessary thread context. Prepare a concise business summary of completed work, blockers/pending approvals, and next steps, then report it to main via agent messaging for delivery to Chris and Bhoumik.

schedules.name: june-backfill-five-days
schedules.text: Run the daily June backwards ingestion backlog. Read workspace/threads/backfill/files/june-backlog-plan.md first, then process the next listed block (up to five June dates) under its exact-farm later-date policy. Keep same suppliers serialized and label every reviewed email. Update the plan after a completed block. After the final June 1 block, pause/remove this schedule and message main asking whether to continue farther back.
